capabilities: Show a per-theme settings tab for themes that publish a @themepadd spec
Author custom controls for any theme via a JSON schema
Apply global customizations across the whole vault
Auto-discover theme specs from theme.css and GitHub releases
Apply changes live to the DOM with layered cascade order
disambiguation: Not a theme itself; it is a settings and customization layer that sits on top of whatever themes you have installed.
extras: Full control schema and planned features live in separate repo docs (THEME_AUTHORING.md, ROADMAP.md), not in the README.
intentEvidence: A PADD (Palette, Animation, Decoration, and Density) modifier for your themes.
problem: Obsidian themes ship fixed CSS with no settings interface, so adjusting colors, density, or decorations means hand-editing snippets.

relations.evidence: BRAT installs plugins directly from their GitHub repository and auto-updates them on each release.

summary: Settings framework that gives installed Obsidian themes configurable controls for palette, animation, decoration, and density tweaks.
